QuestInfo.name: [Tallahart] Peer into the Abyss
QuestInfo.0: Thanks to your efforts, the phantasmal crystal ball has been fixed. Nona would like to speak to you.
QuestInfo.1: Nona says she can read your destiny using Noctis's power in the crystal ball. Try it again.
QuestInfo.2: According to Nona, an ancient god's power shouldn't be able to interfere with your destiny. So what is going on here? Investigate the crystal ball.
